name: Mirah
short_description: Measurement-based care and collaborative care platform with 400+ measures, proprietary adaptive assessments, and the only integrated care technology optimized for pediatrics.
long_description: Mirah is a powerful measurement-based care platform designed to support patient-centered, data-driven behavioral healthcare. The platform offers over 400 clinically validated measures that can be customized at the individual patient level or auto-assigned via measurement protocols. Mirah's proprietary Computer Adapted Multidimensional Scale (CAMS) tracks 16 dimensions (12 symptoms and 4 strengths) using adaptive questioning that adds more questions when concerning behaviors are detected. Uniquely, Mirah is the only integrated care technology optimized for pediatrics, making it ideal for child and adolescent behavioral health settings. The platform integrates with major EHRs including AdvancedMD and Athenahealth, and is approved by the VA for federal use.
one_liner: MBC platform with 400+ measures, adaptive assessments, and pediatric optimization.

faqs.q: How much does Mirah cost per provider?
faqs.a: Mirah offers two pricing models: $75 per provider per month (unlimited assessments) or $48 per patient per year (unlimited providers). Minimum 1-year contract with 90-day termination window after the first year.

CAMS (Computer Adapted Multidimensional Scale) is Mirah's proprietary adaptive assessment that tracks 16 dimensions (12 symptoms and 4 strengths). It adapts by adding more questions when concerning behaviors are detected.

faqs.q: Is Mirah good for pediatric behavioral health?
faqs.a: Yes, Mirah is uniquely optimized for pediatrics and is described as the only integrated care technology specifically designed for pediatric behavioral health settings.

faqs.q: Does Mirah support collaborative care billing?
faqs.a: Yes, Mirah supports CoCM (Collaborative Care Model) workflows and can help unlock up to 25% additional revenues via CPT reimbursement codes.
